title: Brazilian Pastry Pão de Queijo
description: A vegan Brazilian cheese bread recipe made with tapioca flour and coconut oil, perfect for a savory snack or side dish.

ingredients.name: Vegan egg replacement
ingredients.notes: such as flaxseed or chia seeds

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together tapioca flour, coconut oil, garlic powder, salt, and baking powder.
In a separate bowl, whisk together non-dairy milk and vegan egg replacement.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Shape the dough into small balls and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until the bread is golden brown and puffed up.
Remove from oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
